attempts.text:
**The window starts on a three-gene spine.** Columns 0 to 2, `yfeC`, `pdeA` and `nupC`, are carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 1% of calls. The model names 76 to 99% of them, fewest at `nupC`, and hesitates most at `pdeA`, 0.63 bits.

**A fork at column 3** carries two hypothetical proteins, one in 49% and one in 23% of chromosomes, and the model names only 44% of calls there. Then columns 4 to 12, `mntH` to `ptsP`, stay persistent at 91 to 95%, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 3% of calls, named in 83 to 99%, with the most hesitation at `mntH`, 1.46 bits. Column 13, `ypdC`, is variable and easy: 95% named, 0.44 bits.

**Columns 14 to 30 run through persistent spines** with a fork at column 26, `evgS` in 89% of chromosomes beside an IS1-like element transposase in 20%. The model names 88 to 99.6% of these calls and seldom hesitates, at most 0.73 bits at `dsdA`. The `evgA` to `dsdA` genes sit in a region of plasticity in 1 to 22% of calls.

**The long fork and variable stretch, columns 31 to 79**, is in a region of plasticity in 26 to 82% of calls, named in 59 to 89%, and holds the window's most hesitant column, 35, at 2.10 bits. A parallel branch of 5 families, 17 to 28% each, runs through columns 31 to 35; the fimbrial genes `yfcV` to `yfcO` and the `his` genes follow. Inside a region of plasticity the model names 54% of calls against 95% outside, and hesitates 1.79 bits against 0.25. The window ends at `yfcD`, in 16% of chromosomes.

label: yfeC
facts:
WINDOW: the yfeC window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yfeC, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,308 to 1,387 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yfeC once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 84% of genes, 0.65 bits on average (perplexity 2.1 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 30,213 calls, named 98%, 0.22 bits; shell 11,269 calls, named 59%, 1.39 bits; cloud 1,558 calls, named 11%, 3.56 bits. Outside an RGP 31,834 calls, named 95%, 0.25 bits; inside an RGP 11,206 calls, named 54%, 1.79 bits. Columns: 28 spine, 19 fork, 33 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.79 against 0.25 bits) and names fewer genes (54% against 95%); 11,206 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 35 (yfdF) 2.10 bits, RGP 55%; column 34 (mlaA) 1.75 bits, RGP 61%; column 36 (fadL) 1.72 bits, RGP 47%. The 14 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 69%, 1.26 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 88%, 0.52 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 31-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 26-82%; the least: column 13 (variable), RGP 0.2%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-2 (3 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-1%. Genes: yfeC "YfeC-like transcriptional regulator", pdeA, nupC. named 76-99% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 2 (nupC), named 76%; most hesitant at column 1 (pdeA), 0.63 bits.
2. column 3 fork: RGP 3%. named 44%; 0.10 bits.
   3: "hypothetical protein" S 49%; also "hypothetical protein" S 23%
3. columns 4-12 (9 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 0-3%. Genes: mntH, ypeC "DUF2502 domain-containing protein Y…", yfeO "ion channel protein", glk, fryB "PTS fructose transporter subunit IIB", fryC, ypdF "aminopeptidase", ypdE "aminopeptidase", ptsP. named 83-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (mntH), named 83%, 1.46 bits.
4. column 13 variable: RGP 0.2%. named 95%; 0.44 bits.
   13: ypdC P 89% "helix-turn-helix transcriptional re…"
5. columns 14-25 (12 columns) spine: share 91-95%, all P, RGP 0.2-1%. Genes: ypdB "two-component system response regul…", ypdA "two-component system sensor histidi…", alaC, ypdK "membrane protein YpdK", lpxP, yfdY "YfdY family protein", ypdI "colanic acid biosynthesis lipoprote…", yfdX "YfdX family protein", frc, oxc, yfdV "AEC family transporter", yfdE "CoA transferase". named 95-99.6% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 20 (ypdI), named 95%; most hesitant at column 17 (ypdK), 0.30 bits.
6. column 26 fork: RGP 1%. named 96%; 0.33 bits.
   26: evgS P 89% "transporter substrate-binding domai…"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 20%
7. columns 27-30 (4 columns) spine: share 90-93%, all P, RGP 1-22%. Genes: evgA, emrK "multidrug efflux MFS transporter pe…", emrY, dsdA "D-serine ammonia-lyase". named 88-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (dsdA), named 88%, 0.73 bits.
8. columns 31-79 (49 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 26-82%. named 59-89% (mean 78%), fewest named at column 44, named 59%; most hesitant at column 35, 2.10 bits.
   a second branch of 5 families through columns 31-35, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 17-28%, all S; the branch's families: "LacI family DNA-binding transcriptional…", cscA, "PfkB family carbohydrate kinase", "MFS transporter", "hypothetical protein"
